pr.title: fix(dcp): scanner-side control-character fail-closed repair (clean successor, supersedes contaminated PR #1325)
pr.body: Closes a confirmed live bypass: RedLaneScanner silently fails to block exact-match FORBIDDEN_PATHS entries (scripts/dopetask, scripts/taskx, queue_drain.py variants, batch_resolve_and_merge.py) when the path carries a trailing or embedded control character, because the \Z re-anchoring in PR #1322 correctly fixed the wildcard rules but regressed these exact-match rules on the one consumer (the scanner) that lacks the hook's independent control-character short-circuit. Adds an unconditional scanner-side fail-closed check mirroring the hook's, plus regression coverage for exact-match, wildcard, exemption-spoof, arbitrary-malformed, and clean-control cases. This PR is the clean, custody-verified successor to PR #1325, which advanced through unauthorized runtime and proof implementation before an operator-directed gate-reconstruction (TP-DMX-PR1304-RED-LANE-PATH-REGEX-HARDENING-002-GATE-RECONSTRUCTION-001) rebuilt this packet against a fresh worktree, verified donor objects, and a full independent-audit requirement. PR #1325 is left open, untouched, and superseded pending separate operator disposition. Runtime mutation is included once, and only once, the AUTHORIZE_TP_DMX_PR1304_RED_LANE_PATH_REGEX_HARDENING_002_EXECUTION=YES gate is issued. Does not merge without a fresh independent audit bound to the exact implementation head.
